stories.title: Bao and the Picture That Stayed Private
stories.outro: See you next time in Sunny Meadow!
stories.moral: Ask before sharing someone else's work, and respect their answer.
moralRhyme: Their makers choose the sharing day!

youtube.title: Bao and the Picture That Stayed Private | Sunny Meadow
youtube.description: Bao's little gallery had one very empty frame. Sparkle carried a folded picture past the table. A gentle friendship story. Ask before sharing someone else's work, and respect their answer. #SunnyMeadow #DreamyDiscoveries

lines.text: Bao's little gallery had one very empty frame.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Sparkle carried a folded picture past the table.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Your picture could fill my biggest empty frame!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: This picture is just for me, Bao.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Bao looked at his carefully decorated gallery sign.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He had hoped for two pictures on the wall.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then I will leave your picture with you.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Thank you. I would like to keep it folded.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Sparkle put her picture inside a plain envelope.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Bao turned his empty frame over in his paws.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Could I help you find something else to display?
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Yes. I have only finished the gallery sign.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Bao had spent all morning decorating empty frames.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: His own drawing paper was still completely blank.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Perhaps I can draw a whole garden very quickly.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I can help put your colors where you need them.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Can Bao display Sparkle's private picture?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Bao drew six stems in a great hurry.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The last three flowers had no room for petals.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: My enormous garden has run out of paper.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: There is room for something smaller on another sheet.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Bao tried making the petals tiny as dots.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He could hardly see them from the gallery door.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: My visitors will need extremely small eyes.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Perhaps choose one thing you really want to draw.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Bao looked at his round painting-water bowl.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: One small leaf floated gently on the surface.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I like that little leaf beside the window.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Then you could give that one leaf a whole page.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Bao drew a large leaf with a crooked stem.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He followed its shape without rushing the pencil.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: This stem bends differently from the real one.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: It still looks like a leaf enjoying its bowl.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Sparkle moved her envelope away from a wet brush.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Bao offered a dry spot beside her chair.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Your picture can stay here while we work.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Yes, with the envelope closed. That spot is perfect.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Who chooses when Sparkle shares her picture?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Bao added the bowl beneath his finished leaf.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The simple picture fitted his largest empty frame.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: One leaf was enough to fill my picture.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: And there is plenty of room for its bowl.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Bao placed his own drawing on the gallery table.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He left Sparkle's closed envelope beside her chair.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: My gallery will show the picture I made today.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I would be happy to help write its label.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Sparkle wrote Bao's name beneath the leaf picture.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Bao gave their fancy gallery sign a final wipe.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Thank you for helping without lending your picture.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: I can enjoy your gallery and keep mine private.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: They stepped back to admire the framed little leaf.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Sparkle tucked her closed envelope into her bag.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Would you like to tell me about your picture?
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Not today, but I can tell you about yours.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Sparkle pointed to Bao's very round painted bowl.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Its crooked leaf seemed to lean toward the sign.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I think your leaf is inspecting the gallery hours.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Then we had better open before it gets impatient.
lines.speaker: friend
